newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Arianspace says 1996 net profit 150 million francs.
newsitem.headline: Arianspace says 1996 net profit 150 million francs.

text.p: European satellite launch company Arianspace expects its 1996 net profit to be 150 million French francs and sales to be 6.3 billion francs, chief operating officer Francis P. Avanzi said on Tuesday.

"Sales in 1997 will be slightly below seven billion francs and profit will be about the same level (as 1996)," Avanzi told Reuters after a news conference on the opening of a regional company office in Singapore.
Arianspace reported 1995 profits of 170 million francs on sales of 7.0 billion francs.
Avanzi said the 1996 and 1997 figures were lower partly because the company was reinvesting more than 3.0 billion francs in the three years to 2000 on its new Ariane-5 launch rocket.
